hero.headline: Money matters, made clear.
hero.subheadline: Private financial guidance for people who have never felt at home with finance. No jargon. No pressure. Just a trusted broker who explains every option before you decide.

intro.title: You do not need to understand finance to do well in it.
intro.paragraph1: Most people are never taught how money works. They are handed forms, percentages and acronyms, and told to sign. That is not guidance.
intro.paragraph2: As your broker, my job is to translate. I look at your situation, lay out your choices in everyday language, and compare the real costs of each, so the decision you make is one you actually understand.

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: A free conversation about where you are and where you want to be.

steps.title: I do the comparing
steps.description: I prepare a clear summary of costs, benefits and trade-offs.

steps.title: You decide
steps.description: We review the plan together and you choose at your own pace.

promise.title: My promise to you
items: Plain language, always. If a word needs a dictionary, I explain it first.
Your interests come first. I will tell you when an option is not right for you, even if it is the easier sale.
Full transparency on costs. You know what each option costs and how I am paid before you commit.
Discretion. Your financial information stays private and is shared only with your consent.

finalCta.title: Begin with a conversation.
finalCta.description: Your first consultation is free and without obligation. Tell me what you have in mind and I will reply personally within one business day.

mortgages.headline: Your home, without the confusion.
mortgages.whoFor: First-time buyers, owners approaching renewal, and anyone considering a refinance.
mortgages.intro: A mortgage is likely the biggest commitment you will ever sign. I make sure you understand what you are agreeing to before you agree to it.
whatWeDo: Review your income, savings and goals to find a comfortable budget.
Explain the key choices in plain terms: fixed or variable, the length of your term, and how long you take to repay.
Compare offers from [TODO: number] lenders and show you the true cost of each, including penalties for leaving early.
Support you through pre-approval, the offer and the signing.
whatYouReceive: A one-page comparison of your best options.
A clear explanation of every number on your offer.
A reminder before your renewal so you never auto-renew by default.

commonQuestions.answer: The term is how long your rate contract lasts. The amortization is the total time to repay the loan.

savingsInvesting.headline: Put your money to work, at your own pace.
savingsInvesting.whoFor: First-time investors and savers who feel unsure where to begin.
savingsInvesting.intro: You do not need a large sum or a finance degree to start. We begin with your goals, then choose the simplest accounts and products that suit them.
whatWeDo: Clarify your goals: an emergency fund, a home, retirement, or a child's education.
Introduce the main accounts in plain language, such as the TFSA and RRSP, and explain how each is taxed.
Discuss your comfort with ups and downs so the plan is one you can stick to.
Set up a plan and a simple review schedule.
whatYouReceive: A written plan in everyday language.
An explanation of every product and its fees before you buy.

commonQuestions.question: How much do I need to start?
Can I lose money?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes. Investments carry risk and returns are never guaranteed. I will explain the risk of each option before you decide.

commonQuestions.question: What is diversification?
commonQuestions.answer: Spreading your money across different investments so one poor result does not undo your whole plan.

creditHealth.headline: A clear path to a stronger credit profile.
creditHealth.whoFor: People starting out, newcomers building a history, or anyone rebuilding after a difficult period.
creditHealth.intro: Your credit history is a record, not a verdict. We look at it together, without judgement, and decide on steps that make a real difference.
whatWeDo: Review your credit report together and explain each section.
Identify what is helping and what is holding your profile back.
Build a step-by-step plan with realistic timelines.
Prepare you for future borrowing, such as a mortgage or a vehicle loan.
whatYouReceive: Guidance on habits that strengthen your profile.
No promises of overnight results, because there are none.

commonQuestions.question: Can you remove accurate negative items?
commonQuestions.answer: No. Be careful of anyone who promises this. [TODO: confirm wording with your regulator or lawyer]

commonQuestions.question: How long does rebuilding take?
commonQuestions.answer: It depends on your history. I will give you an honest estimate after reviewing your report.

protection.headline: Peace of mind for the people and things you care about.
protection.intro: Protection is about answering one question: what would happen if life changed suddenly? We look at that calmly and cover only what you actually need.
whatWeDo: List what you want to protect: income, family, home, business.
Show where the gaps are, in plain terms.
Compare coverage from [TODO: insurers or partners] and explain exclusions and costs.
Review annually as your life changes.
whatYouReceive: A side-by-side comparison with no fine-print surprises.

commonQuestions.question: Am I being sold more than I need?
commonQuestions.answer: My role is to recommend only what fits. If you are already covered, I will tell you.
